need: Users need an explicitly requested interview to resolve a plan's decisions without starting implementation or imposing an interview on ordinary work.
evidence: The source change recorded one headless run each for three providers. This contribution adds a consumer installation and removal regression that first failed because the interview was absent, then passed with both skill copies and explicit invocation metadata installed.
limits: The generic kit version has not been exercised in live clients or adopted by another project. Metadata support varies by client; the procedure and skill retain an explicit-request guard. Home-server does not install the kit, so this direct contribution does not use an installed-release export.
